info.title: MediCare API
info.description:
Client API for the MediCare clinic system (web app and mobile).

**Authentication:** `POST /api/auth/login` returns a JWT; send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. 401 = sign in again; 403 = signed in but not allowed (never a session expiry).

**Envelope:** every response is `{ success, message, data?, timestamp }`. Errors add a stable `code`, the `requestId` (also in the `X-Request-Id` header) and, for validation failures, per-field `errors`. Branch on `code`, not on `message`.

**Compatibility:** changes are additive (new endpoints, new optional fields, new error codes). Clients must ignore unknown fields and treat unknown error codes by HTTP status.
